basis: New explicit user retry instruction after the reported upstream connection reset authorizes one additional E1 setup attempt. Network recovery is unverified and will be tested by this bounded setup; no separate probe or automatic retry.
execution_scope: One supervised E1 setup, zero model forwards. Existing proxy and AOT repairs are validated. Fresh source extraction and package install use the existing monitored transfer/cache mechanism. E1 retry ends at successful setup qualification or failure; no other stopped work resumes.
